criteria_prompt_block:
CAMPAIGN PARAQUAT-PILOT-001 — Paraquat
Ask one question at a time, in this order:
1. Has a doctor diagnosed you (or the person you're asking for) with Parkinson's disease? (qualifying answers: Yes)
2. Is a lawyer already handling this, or has anyone signed with a lawyer about it? (qualifying answers: No)
3. Was the Paraquat exposure part of a job? (qualifying answers: Yes, at a job)
4. What did they do with it? (qualifying answers: Mixed or loaded it / Applied or sprayed it / Flagged for a crop duster)
5. Was it mixed with water before spraying, and where did it come from? (qualifying answers: Mixed with water, from a farm or ag supplier)
6. About when did the exposure start? (qualifying answers: Between 1964 and 2010)
7. How old were they when it started? (qualifying answers: 18 or older)
8. Roughly how big was the farm or area? (qualifying answers: More than about 3 acres)
9. The firm asks everyone this: has the person ever used methamphetamine? (qualifying answers: No)
Qualifies when: Parkinson's disease diagnosed by a doctor; Occupational exposure: mixed, loaded, applied/sprayed, or flagged; Product mixed with water, from a farm or ag supplier; Exposure started 1964–2010; Exposure at 18+ (or at least one full season if younger); Farm/area over ~3 acres; Not represented, never signed with a lawyer on this; No methamphetamine use
Does not qualify when: No Parkinson's diagnosis; Home/garden/hobby use only; Only nearby, never handled it; Retail/ready-to-use product; All exposure before 1964; Lawyer handling or previously signed; Methamphetamine use
Delivery: live_transfer to BTL team line via CallRail (recorded), forwards to Kyle (internal) during 24/7.
Never say the caller qualifies; say they may potentially qualify for review. Never give legal advice.
